Utilize LabVIEW or MATLAB to develop interfaces for controlling test setups and collecting measurement data. Contribute to technical documentation and participate in internal design reviews. Actively participate in innovation and continuous improvement initiatives within the engineering group. Job Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field (Master’s or Ph.D. is a plus). Proven experience in developing complex embedded hardware systems for harsh environments. Solid understanding of analog and digital system design: filters, amplifiers, data converters, memory interfaces, and communication protocols. Proficiency in electronic simulation tools and laboratory instrumentation. Experience with LabVIEW and/or MATLAB for data acquisition and system control. Strong problem‑solving skills, self‑motivation, and a collaborative mindset. Previous experience in R&D environments is highly desirable. Native portuguese and Fluent or Advanced English is required. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Aqui, você vai: Realizar manutenções em computadores e redes; Realizar instalações de monitores e paineis em elevadores e ambientes externos; Solucionar problemas em sistemas operacionais, em monitores e em transmissores de vídeo; Elaborar relatórios de serviços realizados. vagas.title: Brazil Hull Plan Approval Engineer
vagas.description: Mission This role focuses on performing detailed plan and design reviews, resolving issues related to conflicting design requirements, ensuring client requirements and applicable standards are met. Projects could include the approval of new building, conversion, and existing vessels and yachts. Key Accountabilities Review and approve hull structural drawings of ships, offshore units, and marine equipment, in compliance with Class Rules and Statutory Regulations, for new buildings, ships in service, and ship’s conversions. Assist clients during the design and construction phase, providing guidance and support related to structural design. Resolve issues related to conflicting design requirements and material standards. Perform assessments and provide specialist advice for service delivery, research or development work within agreed broad parameters that include budget constraints and contractual requirements. Oversee and manage day-to-day project elements, visit sites to take measurements. Ensure correct and up-to-date data is used and complete documentation is submitted to officials and other day-to-day duties. Review the project deliverables (technical reports, project performance documentations and engineering drawings, etc). Review progress reports and take appropriate action to ensure requirements are met. Take ownership and responsibility over the financial progress of assigned tasks. Understand and apply project management concepts providing feedback to project manager, serve as reference for the escalation of issues. Manage simple and complex projects assigned applying project management concepts and techniques. Assess complex structural problems for internal/external clients to determine solutions. Answer complex contractor questions on behalf of the supervising engineer, and serve as liaisons between engineering and construction personnel. Education Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Engineering Qualifications Experience Experience in hull design, shipbuilding, or marine engineering, with a focus on plan approval in a Class Society or shipbuilding environment. Experience in the review and approval of hull structural designs, stability calculations, and material selection, ensuring compliance with applicable rules and regulations. Practical experience working with international maritime standards (SOLAS, MARPOL, etc.) and Class Society regulations. In-depth experience in the hull plan approval process, including structural integrity verification, load distribution, and strength calculations. Technical Skills Advanced understanding of ship hull design principles, structural components, and materials used in hull construction. Expertise in reviewing technical drawings, specifications, and stability calculations for hull structures to ensure compliance with design codes and Class Society standards. Proficiency in software tools commonly used in hull plan approval and structural analysis, such as AutoCAD, NAPA, ShipConstructor, or other naval architecture and engineering software. In-depth knowledge of materials used in hull construction, including steel grades, welding techniques, and corrosion protection methods. Additional Information Office located in Centro (RJ). Hybrid work regime (after first period 100% on site). All of our positions are also available to people with disabilities (PwD / PCD). WORKPLACE DYNAMICS - Resourcefulness in shaping progress and working efficiently. FORESIGHT & INSIGHT - Context awareness adopting a systemic perspective and informed decision making. PERSONAL EMPOWERMENT - Ownership for life, work and results, striving to grow professionally and personally. INTERPERSONAL INFLUENCE - Skills and strategies we use to interact effectively with others. DOMAIN & BUSINESS ACUMEN - Applying a scientific approach and critical thinking in operations and solution development within area of expertise. RINA provides equal employment opportunities and is committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and safe from discrimination or harassment of any kind. RINA is also compliant with Italian Law n. 68/99. #J-18808-Ljbffr

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. CR EP GSR 002). Estudos de Reservatórios, incluindo construção, atualização, ajuste histórico (history‑matching) e previsões (forecasting): Construir, atualizar e manter modelos dinâmicos de simulação de reservatórios e outras ferramentas de previsão para os ativos designados, garantindo consistência técnica e rastreabilidade das premissas. Definir e aplicar abordagens adequadas de modelagem (dentro das estruturas estabelecidas da afiliada), incluindo estratégia de history‑matching, lógica de previsão, casos de sensibilidade e envelopes de incerteza. Integrar o entendimento mais recente do subsolo dos ativos aos modelos dinâmicos, assegurando consistência com a interpretação estática e os dados de superfície. Conduzir estudos complexos de history‑matching e previsão, analisar resultados e traduzi-los em insights técnicos claros e recomendações focadas nos ativos. Realizar estudos avançados de reservatórios conforme necessário: integração dinâmica de dados, interpretação e síntese, análise de incertezas, modelagem integrada de redes, análise de mecanismos de produção e suporte à vigilância. Identificar lacunas de dados e falhas de integração que impactem a confiabilidade dos modelos e a robustez das previsões, formulando recomendações à equipe do ativo para estudos adicionais ou aquisição de dados. Garantir a padronização da gestão, armazenamento e indexação dos dados utilizados, modelos desenvolvidos e ferramentas. Integração com a Equipe do Ativo: Atuar como principal colaborador(a) sênior de engenharia de reservatórios para os ativos designados, apoiando os Líderes de GSR e stakeholders multidisciplinares com análises e recomendações robustas. Acompanhar e integrar novos dados de subsolo que impactem o entendimento do reservatório, assegurando atualização tempestiva de modelos e estudos. Apoiar discussões técnicas e avaliação de opções relacionadas a poços, estratégia de depleção e sequenciamento de desenvolvimento, articulando claramente incertezas e sensibilidades. Oferecer mentoria informal e suporte técnico a engenheiros de reservatórios menos experientes. Interações Internas e Externas à Afiliada: (Para ativos operados) Obtenção de dados dinâmicos junto às entidades operacionais e contratadas responsáveis por atividades acordadas de aquisição e interpretação de dados de subsolo, bem como atividades de desenvolvimento de ativos (perfuração/completação, produção, flow assurance, etc.). Quando requerido pelos ativos, contribuição para a comunicação alinhada da TEP‑Brasil com parceiros sobre temas de desenvolvimento de subsolo, produção e entrega de reservas. Liderar discussões técnicas de subsolo relacionadas à sua especialidade durante essas interações. (Para ativos OBO) Quando requerido pelos ativos, apresentar resultados de estudos técnicos que influenciem positivamente o desempenho do operador em desenvolvimento, produção e recuperação final. Liderar discussões de subsolo relacionadas à sua especialidade durante essas reuniões. Promover o compartilhamento de conhecimento entre ativos e no nível corporativo, por meio do voluntariado em lições aprendidas e melhores práticas, em benefício de outros ativos da TEP‑Brasil e entidades da matriz. Responsabilidades: Entregar estudos de engenharia de reservatórios e ferramentas de previsão de alta qualidade, apoiando previsões de produção, avaliação de reservas e atividades de gestão de reservatórios. Garantir robustez e clareza nas recomendações de engenharia de reservatórios, incluindo comunicação transparente de incertezas, premissas e sensibilidades. Contribuir para a tomada de decisão dos ativos dentro do framework de governança e validação da afiliada. Experiência: Mais de 8 anos de experiência profissional em engenharia de reservatórios. Forte cultura de subsolo, com conhecimento operacional (preparação de poços, perfuração/completação e monitoramento), prática avançada de modelagem geológica e de reservatórios, gestão de incertezas, desenvolvimento de reservatórios, previsão de produção, avaliação de reservas e colaboração interdisciplinar. Habilidades interpessoais reconhecidas, com forte capacidade e interesse em comunicação técnica. Histórico comprovado de colaboração ativa no escopo de 2G&R e com outras disciplinas de desenvolvimento e negócios. vagas.title: Gerente de manutenção
vagas.description: O Grupo Seres, em parceria com empresa Industria de Plásticos, seleciona profissional para atuar na função de Gerente de Manutenção Atividades: O Gerente de Manutenção na Indústria PET é o profissional responsável por planejar, gerenciar as atividades de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva dos equipamentos e instalações da fábrica. Seu papel é garantir que todas as máquinas e sistemas estejam operando de forma eficiente e segura, contribuindo para a continuidade e a qualidade do processo produtivo. Principais Responsabilidades 1. Gestão da Equipe de Manutenção Coordenar e supervisionar a equipe de manutenção, definindo funções, delegando atividades e garantindo que todos os membros da equipe desempenhem suas funções de forma eficiente. Realizar treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe de manutenção, promovendo a atualização técnica e a melhoria das habilidades operacionais. Monitorar o desempenho da equipe, realizar avaliações periódicas de desempenho e aplicar feedbacks para garantir a melhoria contínua do trabalho. 2. Planejamento e Execução de Manutenção Planejar e implementar o cronograma de manutenção preventiva e corretiva para todos os equipamentos da planta, minimizando paradas não programadas e otimizando a disponibilidade dos ativos. Garantir a execução eficaz das atividades de manutenção, como lubrificação, inspeção, ajustes e substituição de peças de equipamentos e instalações da fábrica. Realizar análise crítica de falhas e implementar ações corretivas para evitar a recorrência de problemas operacionais. 3. Gestão de Recursos e Estoque Gerenciar o estoque de peças de reposição e materiais necessários para a manutenção, realizando compras, controle e acompanhamento de inventário de peças e componentes. Trabalhar junto ao setor de compras para garantir a aquisição de peças e materiais de qualidade, dentro dos prazos e com o melhor custo-benefício. Controlar os custos de manutenção, garantindo o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros disponíveis, otimizando os gastos com peças, serviços e mão de obra. 4. Melhoria Contínua e Eficiência Operacional Gerir e analisar indicadores de desempenho de manutenção, como o tempo médio entre falhas (MTBF) e o tempo médio para reparo (MTTR), e propor melhorias nos processos. Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos de manutenção, utilizando ferramentas de gestão, como o PM (Planejamento de Manutenção) e o TPM (Manutenção Produtiva Total). Colaborar com outras áreas da produção para entender as necessidades específicas de cada linha e otimizar o uso dos equipamentos. 5. Gestão de Projetos e Inovações Tecnológicas Coordenar projetos de melhorias ou expansão de instalações, equipamentos e sistemas, implementando novas tecnologias ou modernizações nos processos de manutenção. Acompanhar a instalação de novos equipamentos e garantir que os processos de manutenção sejam adequados desde a fase de implantação. Implementar tecnologias de manutenção preditiva, como monitoramento remoto de equipamentos e análise de dados para identificar falhas antes que ocorram. 6. Segurança no Trabalho e Conformidade Regulatória Garantir que todos os procedimentos de manutenção sigam rigorosamente as normas de segurança do trabalho e as regulamentações ambientais aplicáveis. Promover a cultura de segurança, realizando treinamentos sobre o uso de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e procedimentos de segurança. Realizar inspeções regulares nas instalações para garantir que todos os sistemas e equipamentos estejam operando dentro dos parâmetros de segurança e conformidade regulatória. 7. Análise de Desempenho e Relatórios Analisar relatórios de desempenho dos equipamentos e sistemas, fornecendo feedback para a equipe de manutenção e a gestão da fábrica. Preparar relatórios periódicos sobre o desempenho da manutenção, incluindo indicadores como custos, tempo de inatividade, e eficiência dos serviços prestados. Apresentar relatórios para a diretoria e outras áreas da empresa, propondo ações para resolver problemas de manutenção e melhorar a performance da planta. 8. Gestão de Contratos e Fornecedores Gerenciar contratos de serviços terceirizados relacionados à manutenção, como fornecedores de peças, consultorias ou serviços especializados. Negociar prazos, custos e condições com fornecedores, garantindo a qualidade e a entrega pontual dos serviços e materiais necessários para a manutenção da planta. Avaliar a performance dos fornecedores, garantindo que atendam aos padrões exigidos pela empresa. Profundo conhecimento em processos de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva, além de experiência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção (como CMMS). Conhecimento em gestão de equipes, controle de custos e planejamento de manutenção. Familiaridade com as normas de segurança industrial, regulamentações ambientais e boas práticas de manutenção. Noções de controle de estoque e gestão de fornecedores. Habilidades Liderança e gestão de equipes, com foco em desenvolvimento, motivação e resultados. Capacidade de análise crítica e tomada de decisões rápidas em situações de emergência. Habilidade em gestão de projetos, com foco na melhoria contínua dos processos. Excelente comunicação, tanto para reportar resultados para a direção quanto para interagir com as equipes de produção e outros departamentos. Habilidade para trabalhar com indicadores de desempenho e ferramentas de análise de dados. Características Pessoais Proatividade e visão estratégica, com foco em otimizar processos e reduzir custos. Forte senso de organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas atividades simultaneamente. Comprometimento com a segurança e qualidade em todas as etapas da manutenção. Espírito de liderança e habilidade para motivar a equipe a alcançar as metas estabelecidas. Requisitos Obrigatórios Formação superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletrônica ou afins; Experiência sólida em gestão de manutenção em ambientes industriais, preferencialmente em indústrias de transformação plástica ou de produção em larga escala. Escolaridade mínima: Ensino Superior - Concluído Pós-graduação ou especializações em Gestão de Manutenção ou áreas afins são um diferencial. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Data Quality Analyst ID52038
vagas.description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you! ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Data Quality Specialist to safeguard the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of data across multiple integration points. In this role, you’ll monitor incoming data streams, validate calculations, and collaborate closely with development and delivery teams to resolve issues and enhance quality standards. This is a hands‑on opportunity to shape data quality metrics, support Agile processes, and make a measurable impact in a fast‑paced, data‑driven environment. WHAT YOU WILL DO Monitor data integrity and assess the quality of incoming data streams; Report on data accuracy and quality, both internal and external customers; Identify and document data quality issues; Track the issue until resolution with development; Check the accuracy of data calculations; Establish and maintain data quality metrics; Perform primary data validation of new customers’ data; Clean up and correct data manually when necessary; Communicate updates and issues to development and delivery; Participate in user acceptance testing. MUST HAVES 1+ years of data quality experience , preferably in a technical environment that includes numerous integration points; Strong knowledge of Excel (vlookup, countif, concatenate and other various Excel formulas) to manipulate and organize the data; Ability to work with a large amount of information; Proficiency with online research; Knowledge and experience working in Agile development methodology ; Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt in a fast‑changing environment; Strong attention to details and accuracy; Good interpersonal, analytical and communication skills; Self‑motivated, self‑disciplined and result‑oriented; Passion for the data quality discipline; Upper‑intermediate English level , both spoken and written. NICE TO HAVES Basic knowledge of SQL, Postman; Knowledge of EDI, CSV, JSON, XML file formats; Jira, Kibana. PERKS AND BENEFITS Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps. Competitive compensation: USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets. Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies. Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options. Meet Our Recruitment Process The process includes main stages: Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Interview with the Hiring Manager(s). Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit. If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Manager, Access Management Cluster
vagas.description: Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. The Position Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN’S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brasil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well-planned ingress, circulation & egress. The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament. You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location. Key Responsibilities Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites. Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution. Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings. Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements. Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements. Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements onsite and assist all client groups with any access related issues. Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions. Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them. Your Profile Education Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply. Football access management knowledge. FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues. Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people. Experience Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage. Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation. Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment. Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure. Requirements Fluent in Portuguese and English Right to work in Brazil Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
vagas.description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business‑partnering role responsible for portfolio‑level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio‑level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project‑level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward‑looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad‑hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio‑level, strategic mindset. Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. Compensation Reasonable estimate of the current range: $76,400 CAD - $114,600 CAD. This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, and paid time off for sick leave and vacation, among other benefits. Equal Opportunity Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. vagas.title: Analista de Planejamento e Análise Financeira (FP&A)
vagas.description: Analista de Planejamento e Análise Financeira (FP&A) 1 posição Não informado Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR. No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo. Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade; Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho. vagas.title: Jr Project Manager
vagas.description: * Decline will set your Cookie preferences to "Required" and will prevent Kyndryl and its partners from collecting and using Cookie data to collect statistics and to provide you a personalized web experience and more relevant ads on third party websites.Project Manager page is loaded## Project Managerremote type: In Personlocations: Rio De Janeiro, Braziltime type: Full timeposted on: Posted Todayjob requisition id: R-60487**Who We Are**At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.**The Role**Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day. As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail-oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling. But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy. You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. Some projects or clients even involve “embedding” with the client at their location. This puts more visibility on you personally, but it also gives you more opportunity to add value to the relationship. This is one of the things Kyndryls love about working here. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically. Your future at Kyndryl Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a senior project manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of PM roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.**Who You Are**You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Experience • SCRUM or Project Management skills • Basic TI knowledge (architectural) • Organization and planning skills • Teamwork with “one team” philosophy • Fluent in English (written and verbal – OR OTHER RELEVANT LANGUAGE, AS NEEDED) Preferred Technical and Professional Experience • MS Project or other Project Management software • Excellent written and verbal communication skills • Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels**Being You**The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.**What You Can Expect**Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. vagas.title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
vagas.description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more. Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials. Come take off with us! Compensation Range: $150K - $450K #J-18808-Ljbffr

Sobre a oportunidade Em Financial Services (FSO), estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando as necessidades e desafios dos nossos clientes do segmento financeiro (Mercado de Capitais, Bancos, Seguros e Gestão de Ativos) através de uma única área/linha de serviço que une nossas diferentes especialidades (Auditoria, Consultoria, Tecnologia, etc) para atender este setor de forma abrangente e customizada. #FSOEY Você assumirá as seguintes responsabilidades Colabore em equipes multidisciplinares, comunicando-se de forma eficaz e contribuindo para soluções inovadoras em projetos de dados. Utilize pensamento crítico para analisar informações, identificar padrões e propor melhorias. Busque aprendizado contínuo, adaptando-se às novas tecnologias e tendências do mercado, e resolva problemas de forma criativa e eficiente, impulsionando resultados de alto impacto. Requisitos e habilidades que buscamos Nível superior completo ou em andamento nas áreas de Informática, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Administração, Engenharias e áreas correlatas. Proficiência em Python para scripts, manipulação de dados e soluções de ETL. Conhecimento em SQL para manipulação e consulta de bancos de dados. Habilidade em PySpark para manipulação de dados. Experiência com Apache Spark para processamento de dados em larga escala. Conhecimento em Hadoop para armazenamento e processamento de dados. Capacidade de escrever consultas HiveQL e otimizar consultas. Uso de GitHub para colaboração em projetos de equipe. PowerBI ou outras ferramentas de Data Visualization. ElasticSearch: Implementação de soluções de busca, análise, otimização de índices e consultas, e integração com ferramentas. Conhecimento com Databricks. Familiaridade com ferramentas DevOps e IA Generativa. O que oferecemos Na EY, você se desenvolve com habilidades voltadas para o futuro e se abastece de experiências de classe mundial. Nós capacitaremos você em um ambiente flexível e potencializaremos seus talentos extraordinários em uma cultura diversa e inclusiva, com equipes globalmente conectadas. Pelo 4º ano consecutivo, a EY está na lista do Great Place to Work como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, com destaque para as categorias de diversidade. Você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Analista de Suporte Jr (ERP / Sistemas Corporativos)
vagas.description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Ekotruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM! vagas.title: ANALISTA TÉCNICO O&M (464)
vagas.description: A Iqony Solutions do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Iqony Solutions GmbH, fornecedor conhecido internacionalmente pelos serviços especializados no setor energético, atuando em mais de 80 países em todo o mundo. Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro. A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho. Nossos processos seletivos são abertos para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, cor/raça, deficiências, religião, nacionalidade, naturalidade, idade ou quaisquer outras características pessoais. Descrição Suportar tecnicamente todas as atividades correspondentes a execução da Operação e Manutenção nos projetos de sua respectiva área de atuação (projetos), conforme escopos técnicos contratuais. Suportar na execução das atividades técnicas e no auxilio as equipes correspondentes incluindo Planejamento, HSE, Campo e Administrativo diretamente associadas a prestação dos serviços de O&M da respectiva área. Suportar a interlocução com os Clientes de sua área sobre assuntos relacionados a Operação e Manutenção dos projetos. Suportar na elaboração de entregáveis da área de serviços aos Clientes, conforme os respectivos contratos de sua área de atuação, tais como: relatórios, planos e planejamento da manutenção, etc. Suportar no controle dos indicadores de performance da respectiva área de atuação, tais como: Disponibilidade, Performance técnica - PR, desvios de segurança, planejamento e demais metas atribuídas aos projetos. Acompanhar, suportar o recebimento de novos projetos (mobilização) juntamente com as demais áreas da empresa. Responsável por cumprir as diretrizes e procedimentos estabelecidos e aplicáveis as atividades associadas ao O&M nos projetos. Requisitos Técnico em Eletrotécnica ou afins; Conhecimento em Operação de Usinas (térmicas, eólicas, solares ou hídricas) Conhecimento em Manutenção de Usinas (térmicas, eólicas, solares ou hídricas) Conhecimento em execução do Planejamento de Manutenção de Usinas (térmicas, eólicas, solares ou hídricas) Disponibilidade para viagens #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Especialista em Arquitetura Soluções | Infra e Telecom - Arquitetura de Tecnologia
vagas.description: Descrição da vaga Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços. Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay. Desafios estratégicos: O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps. Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário. Atuação de Arquitetura: A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução. A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa. Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia. O que a área te oferece de oportunidade: Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa Diversidade: Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (RJ ou SP) Responsabilidades e atribuições Como será seu dia a dia: Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de Infraestrutura e Telecom, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia tecnológica e de negócio da companhia; Construir e manter modelos arquiteturais, mapas de capacidades, princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos para orientar decisões executivas e estruturantes de I&T; Produzir desenhos arquiteturais de alto nível conectando domínios, plataformas e capacidades tecnológicas; Atuar de forma crítica e consultiva junto às áreas técnicas, questionando soluções, identificando lacunas e propondo direcionamentos estruturantes; Avaliar impactos arquiteturais de novas iniciativas, tecnologias e decisões estratégicas; Incorporar o conceito de AI-First Architecture nas decisões e modelos arquiteturais, promovendo automação, inteligência operacional e uso estratégico de dados; Comunicar e apresentar conceitos arquiteturais para públicos técnicos e executivos. Ponto de atenção: Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo. Requisitos e qualificações Do que você precisa: Formação superior em carreiras de tecnologia, como engenharias, ciência da computação, etc; Pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura, Tecnologia, Telecom, Cloud ou áreas afins. Inglês Avançado/Nativo para leitura, escrita e comunicação; Experiência como arquiteto corporativo, arquiteto de domínio ou arquiteto de soluções; Experiência em ambientes tecnológicos complexos, distribuídos, híbridos ou multicloud; Vivência em Infraestrutura, Telecomunicações ou ambos, com capacidade de sustentar decisões arquiteturais nesses domínios; Experiência na definição de arquiteturas e direcionamentos técnicos em contextos de transformação tecnológica ou organizacional; Experiência em modelagem de capacidades (Capability Mapping) e construção de modelos arquiteturais; Capacidade de definir princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos; Domínio em infraestrutura on-premises, cloud ou ambientes híbridos; Entendimento de resiliência, disponibilidade, escalabilidade, automação e observabilidade em plataformas tecnológicas; Expertise em arquitetura de redes, conectividade e serviços de telecom; Entendimento conceitual de IA e suas relações com infraestrutura e telecom. Conhecimentos que te destacam: Experiência em ambientes multicloud ou arquiteturas híbridas complexas; Experiência com infraestrutura como código e automação de plataformas; Vivência em telecom definidos por software (SDN / NFV); Experiência em integração entre ambientes on-premises e cloud; Conhecimento em uso de IA em operações de tecnologia (AIOps ou Enterprise AI Solutions Architecture); Experiência anterior em arquitetura de soluções, engenharia ou operações, combinada com visão sistêmica; Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link: Ao prosseguir você está ciente e de acordo para realização de sua candidatura nestes termos. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Country Lead, Brazil
vagas.description: Overview Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. Samba is entering the Brazilian market, and we are looking for an entrepreneurial, multi-disciplinary consultant to lead the charge on the ground. This is a true 0-to-1 opportunity: you won’t inherit a playbook — you’ll write it. You’ll combine commercial acumen, business development instincts, and technical fluency to establish Samba\'s presence, build partnerships, drive initial revenue, and shape go-to-market products tailored to local market conditions and regulatory requirements. This role sits at the intersection of commercial partnerships, business development, solutions engineering, and market strategy. We need someone who can pitch to senior brand and agency contacts in the morning, troubleshoot data integrations in the afternoon, and brief our product team on local market requirements in the evening. If you thrive in ambiguity, build structure where none exists, and are energized by the prospect of building a new market from scratch — this role is for you. This is a contract / consultant engagement based in São Paulo. The initial engagement period will be defined based on mutual alignment, with the potential for extension or conversion based on market traction and business needs. Travel within Brazil is expected; occasional travel to Samba offices in the US or other international locations may be required. What You'll Do Own the commercial strategy for Brazil: identify target accounts, build pipeline, and close initial deals across agencies, advertisers, and media companies. Take a consultative approach to sales — educate the market on Samba\'s data, measurement, and audience solutions while adapting value propositions to local needs. Develop and execute account plans for key prospects, manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, and maintain accurate forecasting. Identify, evaluate, and negotiate strategic partnerships with local broadcasters, OEMs, data providers, platforms, and technology partners critical to Samba\'s Brazil infrastructure. Map the Brazilian media, advertising, and data ecosystem — understand who the key players are, where the opportunities lie, and what partnerships unlock scale. Serve as the technical point of contact for prospects and partners — scope integrations, troubleshoot implementation questions, and translate Samba\'s product capabilities into client-specific solutions. Provide technical pre-sales support: run product demos, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and build proof-of-concept solutions that demonstrate value. Develop a comprehensive Brazil market entry strategy encompassing regulatory landscape, competitive positioning, data privacy compliance (LGPD), partnership requirements, and revenue projections. Build the operational foundation for Samba\'s Brazil presence — define processes, reporting cadences, and success metrics. Provide regular market updates and strategic recommendations to Samba\'s international and executive leadership. Who You Are Entrepreneurial builder with 10+ years of commercial experience in ad tech, media, data, or DaaS/SaaS — with a proven track record of launching products, entering new markets, and closing deals in Brazil or broader Latin America. Commercially sharp and strategically minded: you\'ve built pipelines, closed deals, and thought beyond quota to build something new, whether through a consulting, market entry, or strategic commercial background. Technically fluent: you understand APIs, data integrations, programmatic ecosystems, and measurement methodologies well enough to hold your own in technical conversations and troubleshoot client implementations. Deeply networked across the Brazilian ecosystem: established relationships with agencies, broadcasters, platforms, and advertisers, including major holding companies such as Publicis, WPP, Omnicom, Dentsu, Havas, and IPG. Knowledgeable about the Brazilian media and data landscape: including the television ecosystem (Globo, SBT, Record, RedeTV!, pay TV, OTT/streaming, ACR/smart TV), audience data, cross-screen measurement, and data privacy regulations (LGPD). Trilingual: native or professional fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish is required. Self-directed and cross-functional: you operate with significant autonomy, set your own priorities, and collaborate effectively across sales, product, engineering, legal, and marketing, often across time zones. Comfortable at the executive level: confident presenting to C-suite buyers and navigating complex, enterprise-level negotiations. MBA or equivalent advanced degree from a top-tier program is preferred. Samba is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We strive to empower connection with one another, reflect the communities we serve, and tackle meaningful projects that make a real impact. Samba may collect personal information directly from you, as a job applicant, and may also receive personal information from third parties, for example, in connection with a background, employment or reference check, in accordance with applicable law. For further details, please see Samba\'s Applicant Privacy Policy. For residents of the EU, Samba Inc. is the data controller. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
vagas.description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department Events & Entertainment Location Brazil The Position The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Manage the end‑to‑end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision‑making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations. Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures. Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness. Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback. Build team structures and optimise collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), Pre‑Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament. Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony. Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way. Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre‑production workflows with internal teams and external agencies. Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines. Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements. Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high‑level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organise and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision‑maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Direct venue‑level pre‑production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements. Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes. Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE. Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders. Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level pre‑production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior management aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross‑functional planning forums and senior management briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large‑scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team management, creative development, supplier management, and cross‑functional coordination. Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi‑supplier contracts and budgets. Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies. Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments. Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. Organizational Skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. Problem‑Solving Skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. Interpersonal Skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. Cultural Sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. Passion for Entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience of Monday.com an advantage. Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus. The right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr
