vagas.title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
vagas.description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio-level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project-level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward-looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio-level, strategic mindset. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. Experience in optimization of surface well intervention operation using latest new technologies and best practices. Experience in performance optimization, cost control, and operational efficiency improvements in unconventional well environments. Strong expertise in unconventional wells operation, well performance analysis. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Desenvolvedor(a) de Soluções com IA (RJ) On-site Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV. É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso. Como Desenvolvedor de Soluções com IA , sua missão será transformar oportunidades identificadas pelas áreas da empresa em soluções reais, construídas com inteligência artificial — do protótipo à produção, com qualidade e documentação. Desta forma, impulsionando não apenas nossa presença no mercado, mas também a forma como o esporte é vivenciado globalmente. Responsabilidades Desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA a partir de oportunidades identificadas pelas áreas da empresa; Construir agentes, fluxos automatizados e integrações com IA que evoluem de protótipos para soluções em produção, com qualidade e documentação; Implementar pipelines e automações garantindo facilidade de manutenção e legibilidade para outros membros do time; Contribuir com a evolução das soluções de IA corporativas seguindo os padrões técnicos definidos pelo time de engenharia; Identificar oportunidades de reaproveitamento de dados, bases e sistemas existentes , transformando-os em ativos úteis para múltiplas áreas; Acompanhar, corrigir e evoluir soluções em produção desenvolvidas pela área; Criar e manter documentação técnica que permita que as soluções sejam operadas e evoluídas por outros membros do time — inclusive por IA. Requisitos necessários Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência prática com uso de LLMs em aplicações real (automações, agentes, copilotos, etc.); Experiência com APIs REST e integração entre ferramentas e sistemas; Capacidade de transformar uma demanda pouco estruturada em solução funcional, com suporte do time quando necessário; Capacidade de operar a partir de backlog qualificado — recebendo oportunidades estruturadas e transformando-as em entregas técnicas sem precisar conduzir discovery completo; Boa comunicação para explicar soluções técnicas para pessoas não técnicas. Ideal candidates are comfortable working with minimal supervision, collaborating closely with cross‑functional teams, and translating business and technical requirements into clean, maintainable code that delivers real impact for our customers. Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., (occasional extended hours to support deployments or maintain service continuity) Full‑Time position The Company Katalyst Data Management (KDM) is the global leader in hosted subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification, to data storage and organisation, to marketing data online, our specialised data services cater to large multinational corporations, national governments and small independents. KDM’s web‑based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment has enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities. Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities This role is ideal for a full‑stack developer who wants to build modern, high‑impact web applications that power the oil and gas industry. The Intermediate Software Developer – Full Stack will work alongside talented, cross‑functional teams to create scalable, high‑quality solutions across both frontend and backend technologies. Success in this role means delivering fast, reliable, and maintainable applications while turning business and technical requirements into well‑crafted software that truly makes a difference. Key Responsibilities: Develop, enhance, and maintain web applications using .NET 6+ and React. Design, build, and maintain APIs and backend services. Develop user‑friendly frontend interfaces that support business needs. Work with ORM tools and SQL databases (Postgres) to support application functionality. Work with custom domain data types, including geospatial, seismic, and well data. Collaborate with team members to define requirements and deliver new features. Produce clean, maintainable code in alignment with established best practices. Participate in code reviews and support continuous improvement efforts. Troubleshoot and debug issues across frontend and backend components. Knowledge & Skills Required: Strong experience with .NET (6+), React, Docker, and SQL databases Solid understanding of software engineering principles (SOLID, Clean Code) Ability to work across frontend and backend technologies Intermediate English (ability to communicate in meetings). Required Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field. 2+ years of experience in web development. Experience building and maintaining web applications using modern frameworks. Supervisory Responsibilities This position has no supervisory responsibilities. Position Type and Expected Hours of Work This is a full‑time position. As a full‑time position, the eligible to participate in benefits coverage offered to Katalyst employees based on geographical location. Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional extended hours to support deployments or maintain service continuity. Hybrid work model – three remote days and two on‑site days per week. Travel This position does not require travel. All work will be conducted in‑office or virtually. If participation in an offsite meeting or company event is ever requested, Katalyst will cover or reimburse all related expenses in accordance with company policies and local regulations. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Process Engineer - Solomon Benchmarking - Refinery Experience Only- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, P[...]
vagas.description: This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package. Job Overview We are seeking a highly experienced Downstream Process Engineer with extensive hands‑on experience in Solomon benchmarking methodologies and performance analysis to join our Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD). OESD provides specialized and timely operations and process engineering support to all process technologies operated in both wholly‑owned and affiliates' refining and chemicals operating facilities, collectively known as Saudi Aramco Global Manufacturing. Your primary role is to provide technical expertise in conducting benchmarking, analyzing performances, and implementing improvements for Global Manufacturing assets using Solomon performance metrics. This role is crucial in supporting and overseeing the performances of Saudi Aramco's global manufacturing assets. You will use your expertise to drive performance enhancements by identifying and closing gaps discovered through the benchmarking process. Key Responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: Coordinate and lead the administration of Solomon benchmarking studies, ensuring relevance and accuracy for Global Manufacturing facilities. Personally, conduct on‑site data collection, verification, and quality review during Solomon benchmarking in Global Manufacturing Affiliates' facilities. Analyze and interpret Solomon benchmarking results to ascertain the competitive positions of Global Manufacturing facilities in the industry. Develop comprehensive reports documenting findings and actionable recommendations for presentation to Global Manufacturing management and affiliates. Lead the planning, development, and execution of solutions to bridge identified performance gaps, demonstrating measurable improvements. Formulate and implement expense/margin optimization plans to maximize financial performance of Global Manufacturing Affiliates' facilities. Work directly with affiliates' facilities to establish performance targets and measure progress using Solomon metrics. Assess and quantify the future impact of planned capital improvements and modifications on Solomon benchmarking metrics. Develop and present regular performance benchmarking reports capturing the Solomon metrics for all Global Manufacturing affiliates' facilities. Mentor junior team members in Solomon benchmarking methodologies and best practices. You must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. An advanced degree is preferred. You should have a minimum of 15 years of total practical refinery process units experience, with at least 7 years of hands‑on, specialized experience in Solomon benchmarking and analysis of associated metrics in refinery settings. You will have demonstrated ability to apply Solomon benchmarking methodologies to drive tangible improvements in plant performance. In‑depth working knowledge of refinery industry process plant characteristics and operations is essential. Proven ability to facilitate technical discussions and influence various stakeholders, including senior management. Advanced proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to Solomon benchmarking (please specify tools in your application). Track record of continuous learning and staying updated with the latest Solomon benchmarking methodologies and industry trends. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Sales Manager - South & Central America
vagas.description: Sales Manager - South & Central America Drive regional sales growth by building strategic partnerships and technical customer engagement Location: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil About The Role Teledyne Marine Sales Manager Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins. Teledyne Marine is a group of leading-edge undersea technology companies that have been assembled by Teledyne Technologies Incorporated. Through acquisitions and collaboration, over the past 10 years Teledyne Marine has evolved into an industry powerhouse, bringing the best of the best together under a single umbrella. With technologies divided into five core segments; Imaging, Instruments, Interconnect, Seismic and Vehicles, Teledyne Marine sales staff can address not only brand level solutions, but turn-key, customized systems that leverage our full range of technology. Our goal is to provide one-stop purchasing capability, world-wide customer support, and the technical expertise to solve our customer's toughest challenges. A Sea of Solutions…..One Supplier. JOB SUMMARY The Sales Manager is responsible for Sales of Teledyne Marine products in the defined area both directly and through distributors, specific responsibility to support the Central & South America's for Teledyne Marine's Imaging & Instruments and Vehicles verticals. RESPONSIBILITIES Responsibility to build and maintain an active pipeline in a CRM, Salesforce, to exceed orders and sales targets on a quarterly, and annual basis. Provide accurate booking forecasts and keep up-to-date customer and pipeline records. Actively manage the channels to ensure they are fully engaged, optimized, and driven to succeed. Develop and drive a regional sales strategy to maximize market penetration of Teledyne Marine Instruments & Imaging and Vehicles products including new market entries both direct and with channel partners. Orchestrate and hold technical seminars, product presentations and customer demonstrations direct and in conjunction with partners and channels. Remain informed of competitor status, products, advantages, and weaknesses. Develop and maintain a solid understanding of market conditions and trends. Identify opportunities and capture market share growth while collaborating with the Teledyne Marine businesses to optimize efforts. Be responsible for discovering Teledyne Marine non-standard sales opportunities and participate in the selling process in collaboration with product management. Understand fully the benefits and functionality of each of the products in Teledyne Marine Instruments & Imaging and Vehicles portfolio and how they compare within the market. EDUCATION Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent experience Relevant background/education in a maritime organization would be advantageous, specifically hydrography. SKILLS Strong interpersonal acumen, communicate effectively from entry level to C-suite customers. Languages needed – English, Spanish, Portuguese, all at working level. Excellent communication ability with all nationalities, written as well as verbal. Ability to have or attain good comprehension of technical/maritime issues. AUTHORITIES Providing quotations to Agents/Reps within pricing authority Providing quotations to customers within pricing authority Recommend termination and hiring of Agents/Reps within the region based on defined performance criteria METRICS Booking Target Revenue Target Quarterly reports on Agents / Reps Ability to provide timely and accurate booking prognosis. Ability to provide qualitative feedback on market conditions and trends, new customer applications and product ideas Ability to report competitive activity Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Analista de Governança e Processos de TI - Pleno
vagas.description: O MIND é o braço de inovação da Multiplan. Atuamos hoje com um portfólio de 20 dos melhores empreendimento do Brasil, além de diversos outros projetos em desenvolvimento. Com 51 anos de mercado, iniciamos em 2017 uma importante jornada de transformação digital e contamos com você para continuar impulsionando essa missão. Nosso trabalho envolve Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento, prospecção de novas tecnologias e a transformação de ideias em negócios, explorando temas como digital, inteligência artificial, big data, robótica e otimização de processos. Buscamos pessoas persistentes, com mentalidade analítica, visão de futuro e forte orientação ao negócio. E, por fim, mas igualmente essencial, valorizamos profissionais que saibam trabalhar bem em equipe. Estamos em busca de um Analista de Governança e Processos de TI com perfil analítico e focado em conformidade. O objetivo deste profissional será estruturar e monitorar as políticas de TI, garantindo que a administração de sistemas, o controle de acessos e o inventário de ativos sigam os padrões de segurança e eficiência operacional. Este profissional, além de ser um arquiteto dos fluxos e o auditor das normas, terá o papel de executor técnico das pontas em alguns casos, servindo como ponte entre a estratégia da gerência e a operação técnica. Principais Responsabilidades: Gestão de Políticas e Normas: Elaborar, revisar e aplicar políticas de segurança da informação, uso de ativos e conformidade (TI General Controls). Desenho de Processos (ITSM): Mapear e otimizar processos críticos como Onboarding/Offboarding de colaboradores, gestão de mudanças e gestão de incidentes. Controle de Acessos (IAM): Definir a matriz de perfis de acesso e realizar revisões periódicas (auditorias) para garantir o princípio do privilégio mínimo. Gestão de Ativos (ITAM): Garantir a integridade do inventário de hardware e software, monitorando o ciclo de vida dos ativos e a conformidade de licenciamento (Compliance). Administração de Endpoints (Governança): Definir os padrões de configuração e segurança que devem ser aplicados aos dispositivos da empresa via ferramentas de MDM. Gestão de Indicadores (KPIs): Criar e monitorar dashboards de desempenho da TI, níveis de serviço (SLA) e aderência aos processos. Auditoria e Conformidade: Atuar como ponto focal em auditorias internas e externas, garantindo que as evidências de controle estejam sempre organizadas. Requisitos Técnicos: Experiência em Governança de TI, Gestão de Serviços ou Compliance. Experiência em frameworks de mercado como ITIL. Conhecimento em metodologias de mapeamento de processos (BPMN). Familiaridade com conceitos de Segurança da Informação (ISO 27001) e LGPD. Visão técnica sobre administração de diretórios e ferramentas de inventário. Soft Skills (Habilidades Comportamentais): Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de entender como uma pequena mudança em um processo afeta toda a organização. Organização: Necessária para lidar com documentações, prazos de auditoria e inventários complexos. Comunicação Assertiva: Habilidade para negociar a aplicação de políticas com diferentes áreas da empresa. Perfil Ético e Imparcial: Fundamental para realizar auditorias e garantir o cumprimento das regras. Benefícios: Plano Bradesco Top Nacional (com co-participação) Odontológico Bradesco (opcional) Vale Refeição Gympass Trabalho remoto com idas esporádicas ao escritório Incentivo a cursos e palestras pelo Brasil Vaga para carro PPR - Programa de Participação nos Resultados de acordo com a política em vigo do ano #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: A SANDECH foi fundada em 2008, no Rio de Janeiro, com foco na elaboração de projetos multidisciplinares para o setor industrial. vagas.title: Analista Operações Logísticas, AMXL
vagas.description: Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Sejan itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. A equipe da Amazon Logística do Brasil está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time que gerencia as operações de Extra Large (AMXL). Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em escala 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back. Essa pessoa atuará na gestão e execução tática das rotinas nas estações de entrega dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos. Essa pessoa também será a guardiã dos processos e padrões da Amazon específicos para a operação de produtos pesados e grandes (Heavy and Bulky). Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria/visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco para atuar como guardião dos SOPs padrões do node. Key job responsibilities Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias; Orientar e liderar plano de ação com parceiros em busca da excelência operacional; Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos; Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas; Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos; Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações; Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais. A day in the life Seu dia é dedicado a monitorar a Torre de Controle e executar rotinas diárias no node para entregas de produtos Pesados/Grandes (Heavy/Bulky). Você é o guardião dos SOPs da AMXL, realizando consultas no sistema, gerenciando o check-in dos motoristas e abrindo tickets de suporte. Você coordena com a equipe para resolver desafios operacionais para encantar o cliente Amazon. Seu principal contato é o parceiro AMXL, cuja performance você melhora diretamente através de planos de ações consolidados. Requirements Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas. MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros). Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados. Disponibilidade para viagens em 25% do tempo. Inglês básico. Inglês avançado. SQL e outras linguagens de programação. Experiência em Logística, e/ou Transportes de itens volumosos e pesados. Vale refeição Vale alimentação Seguro de vida em grupo Convênio com farmácia Assistência Odontológica Assistência Médica / Medicina em grupo Participação nos lucros Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem-estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito. Diversidade e Inclusão no Grupo Profarma Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena. Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades. Quer fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente? Junte-se ao Grupo Profarma! #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Brand Ambassador / Activation Manager, L43 - Rio, Brazil
vagas.description: The Activation Manager role represents a strategic transformation in how Zamora Company approaches the market. Moving beyond traditional brand advocacy, this position serves as a strategic partner to both On-Trade and Off-Trade channels, with a clear focus on driving sell-out, ensuring flawless execution of our brands across all touchpoints, and delivering measurable return on investment in the Rio region. With a strong entrepreneurial mindset, this individual will spend the majority of their time in-market, working hands‑on to elevate execution. They will lead the adoption of the AVQPAP model (Availability, Visibility, Quality, Price, Activation, Promotion) to bring the Picture of Success to life. Partnering closely with distributor sales teams and key customers, they will identify opportunities, close executional gaps, and build long‑term, value‑driven relationships across São Paulo and the broader Southeast region. This role is critical to advancing Zamora's ambition of building a best‑in‑class route-to-market and execution model in Brazil. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Field Execution & Market Presence Be present in the market on a daily basis, visiting On Trade, Off Trade and Key Accounts, ensuring the correct execution of Zamora’s brands. Accompany the distributor's team in top accounts to guarantee strategic alignment. Monitor and master the AVQPAP execution standards (Availability, Visibility, Quality of Display, Price, Activation, Promotion) across the territory. Identify execution gaps and immediately work with distributors and outlets to correct them. Ensure all points of sale are aligned with Zamora’s brand positioning and premium image. Distributor & Sales Team Development Work hand in hand with distributor sales teams, acting as a field coach and execution driver to generate sell out. Support sales reps during visits, helping them to sell, place, activate and upgrade Zamora brands. Train distributor and customers’ sales forces on ZC Brands (brand building and story‑selling) Trade Marketing & Activation Design and execute point‑of‑sale activation plans tailored to Rio’s On & Off Trade reality. Implement national and regional brand programs in the field, ensuring perfect execution at store level. Lead tastings, bartender activations, menu placements, cocktail programs and in‑store promotions. Be responsible for the quality of execution of key platforms like L43 Puro, Carajillo and Limão. Market Intelligence & Opportunity Detection Act as Zamora’s market radar in Rio. Identify trends, new hot spots, key bartenders, emerging venues and new retail opportunities. Monitor competitors’ activities, pricing, promotions and visibility. Provide regular feedback to the Area Director and Marketing Team with actionable insights. Relationship Building Build strong and trusted relationships with: Distributor management and sales teams Bartenders, bar managers, store owners and buyers Key influencers Become a recognized Zamora representative in the Rio trade. Develop mid- and long‑term partnerships that secure Zamora’s presence in priority accounts. Reporting & Performance Tracking KPIs will be measured in 4 pillars: Business (eg. volume sold on On trade Channel) Commercial Execution (# stores with perfect execution) Promotion (eg, number of trainings) Digital (Eg. reports/ community built) Provide structured reports with photos, insights and recommendations. Help to ensure activities and investments are properly documented and evaluated. REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Hospitality, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in Trade Marketing, Brand Activation, Sales or Brand Ambassador roles, ideally in the alcoholic beverages industry. Having worked with distributors is a plus Deep understanding of On-Trade and Off-Trade dynamics in Rio, with a strong “in‑market” mindset and passion for being close to the consumer (bars, restaurants, clubs, and retail). Good understanding of On Trade & Off Trade dynamics in Rio. Strong ability to execute and drive others to execute. Proven ability to execute with excellence and influence others to deliver against high standards in the field. Strong relationship‑building skills, with the ability to engage and partner effectively with distributor sales teams, bartenders, and retail customers. Analytical and action‑oriented mindset, capable of translating field insights into clear, impactful actions. Highly organized, disciplined, and results‑driven, with strong attention to execution quality. Naturally curious and connected to cultural trends (music, nightlife, gastronomy, fashion), with the ability to anticipate emerging opportunities in the market. Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools. Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus. Willingness to travel extensively within São Paulo state and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends. This role is a key pillar in Zamora’s ambition to build a best‑in‑class execution model in Brazil—ensuring our brands are visible, desired, and flawlessly brought to life at every relevant point of sale in Rio. vagas.description: BANCO DE TALENTOS - MANTENEDOR (A) ELETRICISTA Localidade: Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Que bom que nos encontramos! Levamos em cada vagão os sonhos, as expectativas e os resultados alcançados por muita gente. Sempre com a clareza de que não se pode chegar a nenhum destino sozinho. Por isso, queremos conhecer você, que tem potencial para seguir com a gente e trilhar sua carreira com destino ao aprendizado e muitas realizações. Como será seu dia a dia? Atuação em subestações, quando devidamente habilitado. O que você precisa ter ou saber? Ensino Médio Completo Curso profissionalizante em Elétrica Industrial (obrigatório). Conhecimentos essenciais: Eletricidade industrial; Eletrônica básica; Eletromecânica; Leitura e interpretação de esquemas elétricos e diagramas; Rotinas de manutenção industrial. Familiaridade com registros técnicos e controles de manutenção. vagas.title: Supervisor Comercial
vagas.description: Responsabilidades Você vai liderar a operação de Inside Sales e funis de call, garantindo cadência, qualidade, conversão e previsibilidade de resultados. Gerir funis de call (inbound e/ou outbound), com foco em velocidade de contato, cadências, argumentação e conversão por etapa. Atuar em conjunto com Marketing e Produto/Acadêmico para melhorar qualidade de leads, mensagens, campanhas, régua de relacionamento e narrativa de valor. Treinar e padronizar scripts, objeções, playbooks, cadências e critérios de qualificação. Realizar escutas e auditorias de ligações (call coaching), com feedback estruturado e plano de melhoria individual. Operar com CRM e ferramentas de telefonia/discador, garantindo higiene do funil (atividades, etapas, motivos de perda, previsões). Garantir aderência a boas práticas e conformidade (LGPD, consentimento, abordagem ética e respeito ao aluno). #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Event Experiences Marketing Manager - FIFA Trophy Tour
vagas.description: Overview FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). Department: Commercial & Marketing Location: Brazil Position The FIFA Women’s World Cup Trophy Tour Manager will lead the planning, marketing and delivery of the Host Country phase of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour across Brazil, ensuring a cohesive, high‑impact and locally relevant execution across all Host Cities. They will also support moments on the Global Tour that require local stakeholders, in particular Brazilian Embassies in the 32 participating Member Associations. This role acts as the central point of coordination in‑market, driving alignment across FIFA’s global team in Zurich, local stakeholders and internal functions, working closely with the Experiential Marketing Manager in Zurich. Key Responsibilities Strategy, planning & alignment Lead the development and execution of the Host Country FIFA Trophy Tour strategy and marketing approach across Brazil including all Host Cities. Ensure alignment with the overall FIFA Trophy Tour strategy, adapting where needed to maximize local relevance and impact. Act as the primary point of contact for the eight Host Cities, coordinating planning, timelines, and delivery expectations. Ensure integration with the wider FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project, identifying opportunities to amplify impact across other initiatives. Stakeholder management & governance Manage relationships with Host Cities, local authorities, agencies and key stakeholders, acting as FIFA’s representative in‑market. Serve as the source of truth on local context, sensitivities and opportunities, proactively informing the global team. Lead cross‑functional coordination across FIFA internal teams (Operations, Legends, Digital, Communications, Brand, Partnerships, Media), ensuring all workstreams are aligned, integrated and delivered against a unified plan. Ensure consistent alignment and information flow with the Zurich‑based FIFA team, proactively managing dependencies, timelines and decision‑making across global and local stakeholders. Oversee and approve local plans, including venues, run of show, schedules and promotional activities. Ensure total compliance with FIFA rights, brand guidelines and partner commitments. Marketing, communications & content Oversee the development and execution of local promotional plans across channels (digital, media, partners, on‑the‑ground) in alignment with the broader global marketing and communications plan. Ensure Host City activations are culturally relevant, locally resonant and aligned with the overall campaign narrative. Inspire Host Cities and hosting stakeholders at a local level to invest resources to deliver the best FIFA Trophy Tour events possible. Lead coordination of media activities in‑market, approved by the project team and FIFA Communications. Oversee content capture, approvals and distribution across FIFA channels and stakeholders (including .com, CRM, VNRs, and social platforms). On‑site delivery & operations Represent FIFA on‑site across selected FIFA Trophy Tour stops in Brazil and support on global stops if needed. Oversee delivery of FIFA communications, promotional and content activities, ensuring high‑quality execution and stakeholder experience. Ensure proper representation, handling and protection of FIFA assets, including the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ Trophy and FIFA Legend. Coordinate on‑site stakeholders to ensure smooth operations, including media, partners and local teams. Reporting & performance tracking Monitor progress of the FIFA Trophy Tour across Host Cities and ensure timely escalation of risks or issues. Provide regular and comprehensive reporting on activities, performance and key learnings. Contribute to post‑event evaluation and recommendations for future FIFA Trophy Tours. Global coordination Support the Zurich‑based project team on the global leg where required. Coordinate with FIFA27 Government Relations to pitch the FIFA Trophy Tour opportunities to Brazilian Government representatives and embassies for inclusion in both phases of the FIFA Trophy Tour, to facilitate their involvement in official events and support local engagement opportunities. Ensure continuity and consistency between the global and Host Country phases, capturing and sharing key learnings to inform delivery across the tour. Your profile Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Marketing. Minimum of 5 years of work experience in Marketing and Events or Experiential projects, ideally within sport or major international events. Preferred previous experience in football and/or professional sports. Strong understanding of sports marketing, including sponsorship, brand communication and fan engagement. Proven ability to deliver integrated marketing communications and promotional campaigns across online and offline channels. Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast‑paced and evolving environment. Experience managing complex internal and external stakeholder relationships, including at senior level. Demonstrated ability to work cross‑functionally, building strong relationships and aligning diverse teams towards a shared objective. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to navigate discussions, resolve issues and drive decisions in a constructive and controlled manner. High level of adaptability and resilience, with the ability to respond to changing priorities, evolving plans and a dynamic operating environment. Comfortable working across time zones and flexible working hours, with willingness to travel extensively as required. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools e.g. Monday.com. Requirements Fluent in English and Portuguese. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: FONOAUDIÓLOGO - CER CENTRO - URGÊNCIA E EMERGÊNCIA ADULTO
vagas.description: Responsabilidades e atribuições Executar métodos e técnicas fonoaudiológicas afim de auxiliar no desenvolvimento da fala, escrita e correções das funções estomatognáticas, monitorar e aperfeiçoar os aspectos fonoaudiológicos envolvidos nos distúrbios da audição, motricidade ou facial e incentivo ao aleitamento materno. Efetuar avaliação e diagnóstico de distúrbios de audição e da fala, no setor de EMERGÊNCIA E URGÊNCIA DO CER CENTRO, desenvolvendo programas preventivos e ações corretivas tratando as funções estomatognáticas, da comunicação oral e escrita. Atuar em pesquisa, prevenção, avaliação e reabilitação das desordens da comunicação humana. Realizar triagem auditiva, para o diagnóstico precoce da deficiência e estimulação em bebês, durante o período de internação. Executar atendimento de Motricidade Orofacial ao recém-nascido, teste da linguinha e rotina de promoção e incentivo do aleitamento materno. Avaliar a condição clínica do paciente para traçar estratégias de estímulo à deglutição. Realizar terapias e manobras a fim de tratar e amenizar os problemas dando mais segurança e qualidade de vida para o paciente. Realizar a promoção da saúde das crianças e adolescentes nos aspectos referentes à fonoaudiologia, avaliar suas possíveis causas para aplicar terapia capaz de saná-las. Preencher formulário de avaliação fonoaudiológica com diagnósticos e tratamento. Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e/ou residência no seu setor de trabalho. Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato. Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidas na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes. Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino. Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM. Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD. Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Possuir Ensino Superior Completo em Fonoaudiologia. Meritocracia está no centro do nosso dia a dia. Temos um escritório open space e uma estrutura horizontal onde você vai conversar com os melhores profissionais de mercado e ter desafios reais e diários. Sobre a área: Você fará parte do time de ArtificialIntelligence & Data Science, junto à equipe de DataAnalytics do banco, atuando como referência técnica em engenharia de IA. Estamos construindo a próxima geração de soluções baseadas em IA Generativa e Machine Learning no BTG Pactual, com foco no desenvolvimento de agentes inteligentes, produtos baseados em LLMs e modelos clássicos de ML voltados para geração de eficiência operacional e redução de custos no front office e backoffice do banco. No seu dia a dia: Atuar como ponto de contato técnico entre stakeholders de negócio e o time de engenharia, traduzindo necessidades em casos de uso viáveis com IA; Liderar o ciclo completo de produtos de IA Generativa e ML, da concepção e design de solução à entrega e sustentação em produção; Projetar e implementar pipelines de IA, integrando modelos internos e de mercado em sistemas e plataformas do banco; Ter autonomia para escolher metodologias e tecnologias adequadas, justificando seus trade-offs; Definir e disseminar boas práticas de engenharia de IA, avaliação de modelos e design de prompts dentro do time; Participar ativamente de fóruns técnicos e mentorar desenvolvedores júnior e pleno, conduzindo revisões técnicas e promovendo a evolução do time; Garantir a observabilidade, qualidade e rastreabilidade das soluções de IA em produção; Manter documentação técnica e de processos atualizada, servindo como base de conhecimento para o time. Esperamos de Você: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharias, Estatística ou áreas relacionadas, com ao menos 2-3 anos de formado; Disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma híbrida (3x por semana) no escritório em Botafogo, Rio de Janeiro; Mínimo de 3-4 anos de experiência comprovada como Cientista de Dados, com ao menos 2 anos focados em soluções de IA Generativa e LLMs em ambiente produtivo; Experiência prática em machine learning clássico e ciência de dados, com domínio de bibliotecas como Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, ferramentas de experimentação, estatística e análise exploratória; Bom conhecimento de técnicas de Processamento de Linguagem Natural; Domínio de SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL) e não-relacionais (DynamoDB); Experiência com ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure), especialmente serviços serverless (Lambda, S3, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, SNS); Sólida base em engenharia de software, com experiência em infraestrutura, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, boas práticas de programação; Experiência com Python como linguagem principal de desenvolvimento; Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não-técnicos, adaptando o nível de abstração conforme o interlocutor. Diferenciais: Experiência com modelos de Deep Learning e fine-tuning (TensorFlow ou PyTorch); Experiência combinando modelos determinísticos, ML clássico e LLMs em pipelines híbridos; Vivência em práticas de segurança aplicadas a sistemas de IA (controle de acesso, sanitização de inputs, proteção contra prompt injection, etc); Experiência com testes e estratégias de avaliação de modelos e pipelines de IA (evals, benchmarks, testes de regressão); Experiência com FastAPI e pipelines de CI/CD via Azure DevOps; Conhecimento de ferramentas de big data (Spark, Airflow); Experiência prática em inferência estatística e planejamento de experimentos; Conhecimentos sobre o funcionamento de fundos de investimento, incluindo sua estrutura, regulação e operação, aplicado a desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas para o segmento; Inglês avançado; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR); Auxílio Alimentação e Refeição; Planos por adesão como Previdência Privada e Seguro de Vida; Desconto em Farmácia; Programa de Nutrição; Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida – empresa Cidadã. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Mechanical & Rotating Engineer
vagas.description: Airswift is seeking a Mechanical and Rotating Equipment Engineer (Onshore) to work in Rio de Janeiro in a permanent position with an Oil and Gas Company. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Act as a Technical Authority (Integrity) to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests. Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA/RCA) and develop reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems), ensuring compliance with company standards and international codes, increasing MTBF and reducing downtime. Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with company standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT). Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned. Ensure complete documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders. Monitor the performance of rotating equipment using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection. Supervise and execute Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions. Develop and implement condition-based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime. Develop and implement reliability and maintenance (RCM) strategies, with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost. Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems; recommend corrective actions. Identify and manage problematic components, conduct disposal plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements. Lead the ACR for recurring failures and problems using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify the effectiveness of actions. Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements. Provide daily technical support to Operations and Maintenance areas to resolve machine problems, unplanned downtime, and optimize control/operating parameters. Offer guidance for commissioning/start-up, operations, reviews, and updates of controls/monitoring for rotating equipment. Support capital projects by reviewing maintainability and reliability specifications and ensuring correct installation/alignment according to API/AGMA/ISO standards. Support the preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (ART) and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and systems. JOB QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. MBA/Postgraduate degree in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus. Advanced English required. Experience in operation, maintenance, or reliability of rotating equipment in the Oil and Gas sector (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery. Solid knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services. Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and fault diagnosis. Proven experience in troubleshooting and field condition monitoring. Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machine design, lubrication, mechanical seals (including dry gas seals). Rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis. Practical knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816). In‑depth knowledge of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, dry gas seal systems, and gearboxes. Certification in vibration analysis (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desirable; certifications in oil analysis/thermography are an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. vagas.title: Senior Safety Technician
vagas.description: Allseas is a world-leading contractor in offshore pipeline installation, heavy lift, and subsea construction. We design, develop, and operate cutting‑edge vessels and equipment, delivering innovative solutions for the global offshore energy market. At Allseas, we value safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement, ensuring a secure and healthy work environment for our employees and partners across all operations. The HSE Department at Allseas The HSE Department at Allseas is dedicated to safeguarding the health and well‑being of our employees, contractors, and stakeholders while ensuring environmental protection across all operations. We develop and implement robust safety management systems, monitor compliance with international standards, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Our team conducts risk assessments, audits, and inspections, promotes a proactive safety culture, and provides training and guidance to maintain a secure and sustainable workplace. By integrating health, safety, and environmental considerations into every aspect of our business, we support Allseas’ commitment to operational excellence and responsible performance. Your role Your Responsibilities Will Include Carry out activities and tasks in accordance with Allseas’ corporate objectives. Become familiar with and comply with the Allseas management system. Support and actively participate in the continuous improvement of the management system. Promote a safe and healthy working environment for Allseas employees and contractors working at all Allseas facilities. Identify areas of exposure or improvement within the department or its objectives. Conduct inspections and audits to diagnose the institution’s occupational health and safety (OHS) situation. Identify control variables related to diseases, accidents, quality of life, and the environment. Develop educational actions in the field of health and safety at work. Integrate negotiation processes. Participate in the adoption of technologies and work processes. Take part in investigations and analyses of work‑related accidents and recommend preventive and control measures. Requirements Occupational Safety Technician certificate. Registered by Ministry of Labor. Preferred: Additional certifications or specialization in Health, Environment, or Safety Management. Minimum Experience 5 to 8 years of proven experience in Occupational Health and Safety, preferably in industrial environments, heavy construction, oil & gas, or onshore projects. Hands‑on experience in audits, inspections, risk management, accident investigation, and implementation of preventive programs. What we Offer Competitive Salary Year‑end bonus Meal and grocery vouchers (electronic card). Commuting allowance (public transport or mileage reimbursement). Insurances: Health, Life and Travel Possibility to work from home Childcare allowance #J-18808-Ljbffr

Em um mundo em constante evolução, nossa capacidade para entregar rapidamente os produtos que são comprados através do Mercado Livre tornou-se um requisito para competir. Faça parte da equipe que está liderando a logística na América Latina, oferecendo soluções customizadas de classe mundial e integrando carriers locais e regionais, através de um comércio que não reconhece fronteiras. Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação. Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros. A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas. Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão. Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe. Identificar as oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e tomar decisões estratégicas com o objetivo de criar uma ótima experiência para os que vendem e compram na nossa plataforma. Desenvolver uma equipe altamente eficiente, com os mais elevados padrões de segurança e um excelente clima de trabalho, criando um ambiente onde possamos absorver o máximo de cada um. Garantir ambiente com maximização de ideias diversas, implementação de metodologias para resolução de problemas crônicos e também foco em garantir padronização de fluxos. Participar do processo de escalabilidade do site gerando valor para os usuários internos e externos. Requisitos Ter formação superior completa em Administração de Empresas, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas afins. Possuir conhecimentos de nível avançado sobre Excel, contar com conhecimento sobre tecnologias e inteligência artificial. Possuir experiência em rotinas operacionais, assim como na liderança de projetos, processos ou operações. Ter disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente, em Cordovil - Rio de Janeiro. Benefícios Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo. Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores. Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms). Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results. Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third‑party trackers, etc.) Exceptional analytical and problem‑solving skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Self‑motivated, detail‑oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team. Proficiency with media buying and planning tools. vagas.title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
vagas.description: Overview FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department Technical & Infrastructure Location Brazil Position Summary The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world‑class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards. The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly oversee the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding, and non‑competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums. Key Responsibilities Oversee the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during the planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament. Collaborate with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensure that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Work closely with the Non‑Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project. Serve as the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department. Oversee contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites. Constantly monitor the budgetary impact of dressing operations and report updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. Provide strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offer expertise when required. Adhere to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Maintain daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaise with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Present to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required. Attend department‑specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites. Input into the site‑specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management. Act as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project. Participate in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites. Assist with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensure the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites. Contribute to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Possibly relocate to a Host City for up to three months to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Your Profile Minimum 4+ years of experience delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games, etc., or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.). Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large‑scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi‑faceted events and projects. Experience managing providers of services for world‑class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) in Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. Readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs, as the role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems. Will attend site visits and be away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written). Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: About Agoda At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005 when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries working together in offices around the globe. Our ultimate goal is to enable and increase the use of data in the company through creative approaches and powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, queue systems, BI tools, and data science technology. We hire bright minds from around the world to support senior growth and success within a culture of diversity and experimentation. The team plays a critical role, empowering business users, product managers, engineers, and others to make data‑driven decisions while improving search experience and protecting customers from fraud. Role Overview As an Engineering Manager, Backend/Data at Agoda, you will lead a team of talented engineers in building and scaling robust backend and data platforms that power critical products and services. This role involves designing distributed systems, data pipelines, and high‑throughput, low‑latency services, ensuring reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence. You will also work on fintech‑related platforms and transaction‑heavy systems such as payments, financial operations, and other business‑critical flows requiring accuracy, resilience, and performance. Responsibilities Lead a high‑performing engineering team while staying hands‑on with coding, code reviews, and technical guidance. Coach engineers through technical problem‑solving, design discussions, and day‑to‑day development. Architect scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems in a high‑traffic, data‑intensive environment. Drive engineering across backend services, infrastructure, performance, data, client‑facing systems, and fintech‑related platform capabilities. Own production systems, including operational health, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and security. Shape engineering best practices across software design, architecture, testing, system operations, and secure engineering. Develop people through mentoring, feedback, and career growth support. Hire and scale strong engineering talent. Partner with cross‑functional stakeholders to deliver impactful business, product, and platform outcomes. Use data‑driven decision making to improve team effectiveness and delivery. Requirements Strong hands‑on coding ability in at least one language such as Java, Scala, or C#. Experience in systems architecture and scalable, fault‑tolerant distributed systems. Experience as a system owner with operational responsibility for production services. vagas.title: A CARREIRA DO FARMACÊUTICO DE ASSUNTOS REGULATÓRIOS
vagas.description: A carreira farmacêutica especializada em regulação sanitária de indústrias, distribuidoras e empresas do varejo farmacêutico é uma das mais valorizadas pelo mercado de trabalho. Esta carreira possui grande projeção profissional no meio industrial e em órgãos reguladores, em que existe maior complexidade nas atividades realizadas pelo profissional, consequentemente as maiores remunerações estão em localidades que possuem polos industriais farmacêuticos, como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, Brasília e Pernambuco. Ser especialista em regulação sanitária exige do profissional aptidão para tarefas administrativas, conhecimentos aprofundados em legislação sanitária nacional e internacional e capacidade de negociação, liderança, comunicação e gestão. O inglês é indispensável e o espanhol pode ser um diferencial para grandes empresas farmacêuticas brasileiras, que detêm filiais na América Latina. A competição profissional nesta carreira é acirrada, pois a atuação não é restrita ao farmacêutico por força de lei. Dessa forma, o profissional formado em Farmácia compete com praticamente todos os profissionais de saúde, advogados e até administradores de empresas. Responsabilidades na indústria de medicamentos e em consultorias especializadas: Acompanha os processos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Analisa relatórios de qualificação e validação; Acompanha e avalia o mercado e os lançamentos de novos produtos dos concorrentes; Administra e executa o processo de registro de novos produtos farmacêuticos na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa); Acompanha diariamente as publicações da Anvisa no Diário Oficial da União (D.O.U.); Discute novas resoluções em Consultas Públicas na Anvisa; Acompanha e implementa novas resoluções e regras sanitárias; Recebe e acompanha auditoria sanitária; Administra o processo de revalidação do registro de produtos; Acompanha o sistema de atendimento ao cliente (SAC) e registros do setor de farmacovigilância; Orienta o departamento de marketing em publicidades e propagandas; Orienta o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Verifica os registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento. Responsabilidades nos órgãos reguladores: Acompanha o cumprimento de normas e legislação por parte das empresas; Propõe e debate com o mercado o desenvolvimento de novas resoluções e regulamentações; Fiscaliza a qualidade e o seguimento de regras na produção de produtos farmacêuticos; Fiscaliza a comercialização de produtos farmacêuticos; Regulamenta o preço dos medicamentos; Regulamenta os tipos de medicamentos e suas formas de comercialização; Regulamenta o comércio farmacêutico e suas características de consumo. Orienta e acompanha o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Cuida dos registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento; Orienta e fiscaliza condições de estoque e armazenamento de produtos; Acompanha e fiscaliza condições de transporte e distribuição de produtos farmacêuticos. Áreas de atuação: Indústrias farmacêuticas; Empresas de logística farmacêutica; Consultorias especializadas; Vigilância sanitária de estados e municípios (Visa). O curso de graduação em Farmácia é o mais indicado para profissionais que desejam seguir carreira em Assuntos Regulatórios principalmente na indústria de medicamentos. É importante ressaltar que profissionais que desejam atuar em agências reguladoras, como a Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa), é necessária a aprovação em concurso público específico. O curso de graduação em Direito também têm peso e relevância. Uma especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios é obrigatória. Existe também a opção de especialização em Logística Farmacêutica para os profissionais que atuam especificamente em distribuidoras. Para que o profissional se mantenha atualizado é imprescindível que ele acesse, com periodicidade, o conteúdo específico da área farmacêutica publicado no Diário Oficial da União e o site da Anvisa, para manter-se informado sobre novas legislações e consultas públicas vigentes. O ICTQ - Instituto de Pesquisa e Pós-Graduação para o Mercado Farmacêutico tem em seu portal na internet um canal de notícias atualizado diariamente com as novidades demandadas pela Anvisa, vale a pena acompanhá-lo. O mesmo Instituto é pioneiro no Brasil com curso de especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios na Indústria Farmacêutica, além de oferecer a pós graduação em Gestão, Logística e Distribuição Farmacêutica. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.title: Gerente de Obras - Presencial no Ceará - (Construction Project Manager)
vagas.description: We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Construction Project Manager on-site in Ceará, Brazil to join our project team within the real estate development and construction business, focusing on boutique hospitality assets. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing construction projects from inception to completion, ensuring that timelines, budgets, and quality standards are met. You should be able to work independently on day-to-day tasks, coordinate effectively with the project team, and provide accurate reports and updates regularly. You will be a member of a growing Project Management Office and will collaborate closely with the entire design and construction team, including architects, interior designers, structural and MEP engineers, the FF&E procurement team, and client representatives. This role will focus primarily on construction execution, contractor management, and schedule delivery, with engagement in cost control, risk management, and project planning throughout the lifecycle. We expect you to be fluent in English and proficient in software such as Google Sheets, AutoCAD, and Revit. Knowledge of procurement, tender management, contract administration, and construction processes is also required. To succeed in this role, you should have excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, be punctual, detail-oriented, and motivated to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to the highest quality. What you will do Assist in planning and scheduling construction activities to ensure timely project completion. Coordinate with architects, engineers, and contractors to ensure project requirements are met. Support procurement efforts by obtaining quotes and negotiating with suppliers and subcontractors. Track project progress, identify potential delays, and propose corrective actions. Monitor construction budgets, ensuring cost control and financial reporting accuracy. Assist in preparing and reviewing contracts, work orders, and change orders. Prepare and maintain project documentation, including reports, schedules, and meeting minutes. Facilitate communication between stakeholders, ensuring alignment on project goals. Support in resolving any construction-related issues that may arise. Reporting directly to the Sr.Project Manager regarding overall project performance. Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field. Work Experience: Proven experience in construction project coordination, project management (+6 years). Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Excel, Google Sheets, AutoCAD) as well as data analysis (Power BI, Looker Studio). Experience in data analysis, including cost tracking, schedule performance metrics, and trend reporting. English fluency is required for this role. What we can offer you Full-time, on-site role in Ceará, Brazil National relocation within Brazil supported Opportunity to work on a landmark luxury hospitality project from construction through delivery Collaboration within a professional, international, multidisciplinary team Utopia does not provide visa sponsorship for this position. #J-18808-Ljbffr

vagas.description: Agente Educativo Junior – Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio. Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Agente Educativo Jr. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Agente Educativo Jr será responsável por atuar no apoio às exposições e atividades do Centro Cultural Light, assistência e orientação ao público, apoio às atividades educativas, recreativas, imersivas e de lazer, bem como o apoio operacional às atividades programadas pela equipe educativa. Apoiar a recepção, orientação e organização do fluxo de visitantes às exposições e espaços museológicos do Centro Cultural Light; Auxiliar visitantes com necessidades especiais, garantindo acessibilidade adequada e uma experiência inclusiva; Orientar o público quanto às regras de visitação, conservação dos espaços e uso adequado dos equipamentos; Apoiar a execução de atividades recreativas, imersivas e lúdicas programadas pelo Time Educativo do Centro Cultural Educacional Light; Fornecer apoio logístico a atividades educativas, escritórios, visitas mediadas e atividades especiais; Apoiar a montagem, organização e desmontagem de materiais utilizados nas atividades; Contribuir para a manutenção do espaço expositivo, garantindo condições adequadas para a preservação de dois ambientes; Zelar pela correta utilização dos espaços de exposição e pela qualidade da experiência do visitante; Colaborar com a equipe do Time Educativo do Centro Cultural Light, garantindo apoio, segurança e organização durante esses anos; Elaborar relatórios diários das atividades realizadas.
